_comment: SAMPLE org-specific leak patterns for leak_scan.py. Copy to config/leak-patterns.local.json (gitignored) and replace the examples below with YOUR organization's internal markers. leak_scan.py ALWAYS applies its built-in generic patterns (personal paths, home paths, 12-digit cloud account IDs) regardless of this file; these org patterns are ADDED on top. Each entry: label (short id), regex (Python re, matched case-insensitively), note (why it's flagged). Anything matched BLOCKS publish.
